title: One of the nicest deep frying pans on the market today!
text: One of the nicest deep frying pans on the market today!. This is my second Ayesha Curry product. I love the way these pots and pans are made. True quality and nice weight to all of them. I particularly like this deep frying pan which is larger than the pan I currently have. Great for making fried chicken or just some large chicken and rice dishes. The lid is perfect and seals over the food perfectly. I will be buying a complete set to replace all of my pots and pans as soon as I can afford the entire line. Very impressed with this line. Would make a great a great bridal shower or housewarming gift. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Hard Anodized Collection Nonstick Frying Pan, 8.25-Inch, Charcoal
features: OVEN TO TABLE: Stylish nonstick frying pan from Ayesha Curry is crafted from hard anodized aluminum for fast, even heat with extra durability for busy, modern kitchens
CONVENIENCE & EASE: Hard anodized frying pan features a premium, inside and out nonstick for effortless food release and easy cleanup
MADE TO LAST: Thicker gauge hard anodized aluminum cookware is 6X harder than regular aluminum cookware for extra durability and long-lasting, metal utensil safe nonstick performance
SILICONE GRIP HANDLES: Dual riveted, stainless steel handle features a silicone grip for a cool, comfortable hold from stovetop to oven to table
OVEN SAFE: Easy cleaning, high performance nonstick kitchen skillet is oven safe to 400°F
description: Make a quick batch of fluffy scrambled eggs or Ayesha's Easy Pan Steaks with this versatile nonstick kitchen skillet from the Ayesha Curry Hard Anodized Collection. Designed for practical performance with a stylish touch, this small nonstick frying pan features thicker gauge, hard anodized aluminum construction for fast, even heat and extra durability to match the pace of busy, modern kitchens. A sleek, versatile design pays special attention to the details that make cooking feel less like work like a triple-layer premium nonstick surface for foods that glide off the pan with ease and an extra nonstick exterior finish to make cleanup a breeze. Sleek, stainless steel and silicone handles give a secure, comfortable hold, and because oven-to-table versatility and convenience is a must, this hard anozided nonstick cookware is oven safe to 400 degrees! Make some memories and bring the family together for great meals made easier with the Ayesha Curry Hard Anodized Nonstick Frying Pan.
